runtimeMapping.device: Own original Front/Back Crawler Protection Unit, no attack or skill hit events. SourceDP5/cooldown15/zero deployment slots/max2 active. E0supply2/E1E2supply3, stock reset on owner birth, no lifetime expiry. ALL low/high deployment; one forward tile.
runtimeMapping.barrier: Selected token talent .10/.12/.15/.17/.20/.22 of live ownerMAXHP; persistent zero-valued core. One union across same-owner overlappingdevices; lost membership removes derived core. Accepted ordinary Physical/Arts/True damage drains pool and resets quiettimer.
runtimeMapping.quietTimer: Source5s first timer followed by derived1s wait-first recurring timer. First local ordinary restoration after6s without accepted damage; each pulse6% live ownerMAXHP cappedselected ratio. Normal clock advances but suppressed in S2.
runtimeMapping.S1: All10 passive ranks; self plus ordinary operators retaining actual positive deviceBarrier gain selected s1_atk/s1_def. One attr buff, no device stacking; marker lost atzero and restoredonregeneration. SourceforceTick1/.2 polling retained.
runtimeMapping.S2: All10 manual timeSP ranks;30s stopattacking, selectedMaxHP/DEF stats, literal Begin.433/Loop2.667/End.433 presentation with nofakehit. ForceTick/.1 aura gives firstimmediate then1s6%-HP regeneration despite damage, with live cap; source ratio restored on finish.
runtimeMapping.emptyTokenSkills: Both sktok passives have zeroSP/zeroDuration/no blackboard and emptynative skillhandlers. Stored and validated, no manual button, recycle or stock refill inferred from unused cathy_s_2[recycle].
runtimeMapping.cleanup: Ownerretreat/death kills alldevices and removes own pools/attributes; newdeploy resets source stock. Source aura noClearOnDisappear keeps owner/device hidden host effects, ordinary recipientfree/isolation removal remains bounded.
